_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/damage/test_dealt_damage_batched.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. t_ddb_hero is the second ability of Hercules, Olympian Hero on a {G} 2/5: the first time each turn it is dealt damage, that many +1/+1 counters. t_ddb_grower is the same line without the per-turn cap, so a second damage event visibly fires it again. t_ddb_near_miss is t_ddb_hero without `batched`, the near miss that reads one source's damage. The bears, the first striker and the bolt come from testing.cards.json.
